transcript:
It was a typical Tuesday morning when I entered the class some students were laughing and having their own tiny conversation while others were going around the class to greet one another overlapping conversation something that I had grown used to everyday filled the room Then I spotted my best friend Mary I went to her and greeted her with a pleasant smile we were best friends from kindergarten she would always hang out in my house every friend friday after school We would also share very secrets with one another as well Just then the teacher walked in Instantly everyone went back to their seat The moment was quick but natural something that happened everyday with not much thought in it So Mary and I settled in our seats ready to start the lesson
Then my teacher Ms Tan assigned us some work to do Moment after I started doing my assignment I heard something that caught my attention I heard a bunch of student from the table beside me talking about something very personal about me It was also one of the secrets that I only told Mary and not a single soul in the class how do they know how much do they know what more would they know and most importantly how would have told them All these such thoughts filled my mind
Just then a thought that I would never think of popped in my brain what if Mary told them I thought I was speechless For the whole lesson I was thinking how could Mary possible betray me like that After a while the recess bell rang Upon hearing that the students rushed to hand in the paper and bolted down to the school canteen wanting to beat the long line on the stairs As I made my way slowly down to the canteen still in disbelief of what happen in class earlier
When I reached the canteen I spotted Mary without hesitation I stomped towards her as I was raging with anger Why would you do such a thing I trusted you telling to keep my secret and you go around people about it I shouted She was looking so lost in my word and looked she had absolutely no idea what I was talking which made me even frustrated Oh stop pretending like you do not know what I am talking about I raised my voice once more Before she could say a word I angrily walk away
For the whole day I avoided her not wanting to see her When she kept coming up to me to explain herself I kept going away from her Later the teacher parted us together so I had not choice but to talk to her Then she asked if she would explain herself one more time I said fine in a surn voice while crossing my arms Mary said that she would never tell anyone my secret as she knew how much it meant to me and that other might just over hear us talking At that second a wave of embarrassment washed over me I apologized sincerely to her for accusing her unfairly and for refusing to let her explain the problem Although she was hurt by my action she eventually forgave me
The experience taught me that trust can easily be damage with assumptions and impulsive actions From that day onward I learned that I should not assume something that I do not know fully about and I also learned to stay clam and communicate properly before jumping to conclusion.

errors.note: Compound word should be two separate words.
Question mark should be placed inside quotation marks.
Use of 'else' is more appropriate here.
Verb form should be past participle.
